Patrón Mini Tigrito Amigurumi 🐯 Materiales Hilo naranja, blanco y negro Crochet 2.5 mm o 3 mm Ojos de seguridad 6 mm Aguja lanera Relleno siliconado Abreviaturas AM = anillo mágico pb = punto bajo aum = aumento dism = disminución pe = punto enano cad = cadena Cabeza y cuerpo (una sola pieza) Con naranja V1: 6 pb en AM (6) V2: 6 aum (12) V3: (1 pb, 1 aum) x6 (18) V4: (2 pb, 1 aum) x6 (24) V5-8: 24 pb Colocar ojos entre vueltas 6 y 7. V9: (2 pb, 1 dism) x6 (18) Rellenar cabeza. V10: (1 pb, 1 dism) x6 (12) Ahora comienza el cuerpo: V11: 12 pb V12: (1 pb, 1 aum) x6 (18) V13-16: 18 pb V17: (1 pb, 1 dism) x6 (12) Cerrar y rellenar. Orejas (x2) Con naranja: V1: 6 pb en AM V2: 6 aum (12) Doblar y coser arriba de la cabeza. Brazos (x2) V1: 6 pb en AM V2-6: 6 pb Rellenar ligeramente y coser. Piernas (x2) V1: 6 pb en AM V2: 6 aum (12) V3-5: 12 pb Coser en la parte inferior. Cola Hacer 18 cadenas. Regresar con puntos bajos. Coser detrás del cuerpo. Detalles Con hilo negro bordar: Rayitas del tigre Nariz Boca Con hilo blanco hacer el hocico. Tip para que quede más bonito ✨ Usa poco relleno en brazos y cola para que el tigrito tenga un acabado más suave y tierno. #amigurumi #crochet #amigurumis #tejidoamano #crochettiktok

🔥 I’ve completed my second prototype of a fan-laced crochet corset. This time, I incorporated synthetic whalebone as a type of corset boning, which is better than the spiral steel boning I used in my first version. It looks more structured than my initial attempt. The boning is securely stitched underneath the corset using a boning tunnel/casing. I used a sturdy wax cord that can withstand pulling for the lacing. I paired it with my freehand crocheted bustier top. This corset is for aesthetic purposes only and is a statement piece in your wardrobe. It will not function as a traditional corset because it is a crocheted version with added structure.  The crochet pattern will be available for purchase soon! It is currently in the testing phase.
